The '''Agents of Ossus''' were a secretive group of surviving [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and other [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] who sought to preserve the [[Jedi Code/Legends|memory]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] after it was [[Order 66/Legends|eradicated]]. Named after the [[Jedi library|famous repository]] of the then lost [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], its founder, [[Jin-Lo Rayce]], a former [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] and survivor of [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], kept lore of the Jedi safely hidden from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
Fleeing [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|attack on the Jedi Temple]], [[Jin-Lo Rayce]] made his way first through the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]], then to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. There, he set about locating any other survivors of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. To his dismay, all he was able to locate were untrained [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]]. Undaunted, he formed these [[Force Adept|adepts]] into secret cells, training them in the basics of [[Force power/Legends|Force use]]. He named his organization after the [[Jedi library|famous repository]] of Jedi knowledge, the then lost [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. Their purpose would be to retain the lore of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], and keep it safely hidden from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TFU CG" />

Eschewing the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] as a primary weapon, Rayce had his pupils focus on the more ubiquitous weapons of the era: [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblades]]. Their Force-enhanced abilities with these weapons were impressive. They also learned how to conceal their presence, both [[Art of the Small|in the Force]], and [[Force cloak|visually]] from the seemingly omnipresent [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]]. Repeated captures by Imperial agents made the group cautious and hesitant to increase their numbers by much, and the group never extended far beyond the developed Core.<ref name="TFU CG" />
